meta.about: Evidence-quality registry: for every source, when it was observed, how fine it is, where it covers, who may use it, and how far it was checked; for every finding, which sources it rests on and what it actually applies to. Hand-maintained and enforced by tests: the engine cannot emit a finding that is not listed here.

validation.validated: compared with an independent reference and agreed (agreement may still be modest)
validation.internal-check: recomputed or cross-checked from the same source family; the source itself was not checked against the ground
validation.negative: tested against an independent reference and did NOT agree
validation.not-applicable: a pointer, definition or live service rather than a measurement

nature.snapshot: a map or record of one moment

scope.pin: computed at the exact pin position (point in a mapped shape)
scope.nearby: describes features within a stated distance of the pin
scope.area: an estimate from several nearby records or a regional map unit
scope.ward: a value for the whole GHMC ward the pin is in
scope.mandal: a value for the whole mandal
scope.locality: a value for a named locality
scope.parcel: the matched survey-parcel outline (only when the pin matches exactly one outline; a survey number can hold many house plots)

meta.files_note: files: the web/data files a source is loaded from; tests remove them one at a time and check that no finding turns reassuring

sethu_model.name: SETHU ward flood model
sethu_model.provider: this project (terrain, drainage and land-cover features; labels from news-named flooded wards)
sethu_model.coverage: the 145 GHMC wards only; not applied outside
sethu_model.licence_note: labels come from news reports; input datasets' terms not all confirmed
sethu_model.validation_note: tested on floods it never saw (leave-one-event-out) AUC about 0.69: better than chance, modest; labels cap what any model can reach
sethu_model.limits: ranks wards, not streets; news-named wards are not the only wards that flooded

tsdps_storms.name: Storm rainfall by mandal (8 documented floods)
tsdps_storms.provider: Open Data Telangana (TSDPS) daily mandal rainfall
tsdps_storms.validation_note: 14 Oct 2020 mandal readings average 211 mm against the 192 mm reference
tsdps_storms.limits: mandal rain is not rain at the plot; a ward named in news is not the only ward that flooded

tsdps_monsoon.name: Heavy-rain days per monsoon
tsdps_monsoon.provider: Open Data Telangana (TSDPS) daily weather files, June-October 2018-2025
tsdps_monsoon.coverage: 27 mandals, 5-7 complete monsoons each (2025 excluded: incomplete file)
tsdps_monsoon.validation_note: recomputed independently at 4 places (28 yearly counts, no mismatch); agrees with the older file series on 4,104 shared mandal-days
tsdps_monsoon.limits: 2025 storms are not in the counts; too few seasons for a return period

osm.name: Roads, hospitals, schools, shops and other places
osm.provider: OpenStreetMap (Overpass) merged with Overture Maps places
osm.coverage: study box; completeness varies by neighbourhood
osm.licence_note: OSM is ODbL (attribution and share-alike); Overture terms vary by theme
osm.validation_note: nothing checks that a mapped hospital or school still operates or offers the service named
osm.limits: undated; mapping gaps look like 'nothing nearby'

opencity_transit.name: Bus stops, metro stations, police stations
opencity_transit.provider: OpenCity / Telangana open data (TSRTC, HMRL GTFS stops, Hyderabad police)
opencity_transit.licence_note: listed as public domain by OpenCity; original terms not confirmed
opencity_transit.validation_note: stop locations only; no timetable, frequency or service check
opencity_transit.limits: undated; presence of a stop does not mean a usable service

health_gis.name: 108 ambulance stations and health facilities
health_gis.validation_note: locations not checked on the ground

openmeteo_elev.name: 90 m elevation around the pin
openmeteo_elev.licence_note: free tier is non-commercial; needs a paid plan or another source before real traffic
openmeteo_elev.limits: fetched when the report opens; if the call fails the finding says so

openmeteo_air.name: Air quality now
openmeteo_air.validation_note: a modelled snapshot of the current hour, not a measurement at the pin
openmeteo_air.limits: one hour; says nothing about typical air

osrm.name: Road travel time and distance
osrm.provider: OSRM public demo servers on OpenStreetMap roads (two hosts, failover)
osrm.licence_note: public demo servers; not for production traffic
osrm.validation_note: the second host runs the same engine and data, so it is a failover, not an independent check; no Google comparison was run
osrm.limits: no live traffic; typical car speeds; 'nearest' facility is by straight line first

tgrac_nalas.name: GHMC nalas, drains and listed inundation points
tgrac_nalas.provider: Telangana State GIS (TGRAC) GHMC Nalas and Vulnerability map
tgrac_nalas.licence_note: OpenCity lists it public domain; original terms not confirmed
tgrac_nalas.validation_note: audited for blanks and duplicates; encroachment fields are all zero in the source and are not shown as data
tgrac_nalas.limits: survey date unknown; only the map-document creation date is published

hydraa_tanks.name: Tank status 2014 vs 2023
hydraa_tanks.validation_note: satellite class (live / encroached), not a legal finding
hydraa_tanks.limits: satellite-based status; not the legal lake boundary

hmda_lakes.name: HMDA lake list and FTL notification status
hmda_lakes.validation_note: matched to tank outlines by name, which can mis-match
hmda_lakes.limits: no outlines; names matched, not coordinates

tgrac_waterbodies.name: Tank capacity records and stream order
tgrac_waterbodies.coverage: 2,048 de-duplicated tank records (capacity for 750), 1,355 stream segments
tgrac_waterbodies.validation_note: recomputed independently from the raw download at six places with no mismatch; capacity is the source's area x bund / 2 estimate and is missing for 63% of tanks
tgrac_waterbodies.limits: present-day storage not measured; streams are terrain-derived and do not prove a buried channel

tgrac_gwp.name: Groundwater potential map
tgrac_gwp.validation_note: read correctly from the service; accuracy and survey date not published
tgrac_gwp.limits: regional map unit, not the ground at the pin

tgrac_lost.name: Disappeared water bodies
tgrac_lost.validation_note: read correctly; accuracy and survey date not published
tgrac_lost.limits: a map record, not a legal finding

tgrac_tcur.name: Forest boundary, high-voltage lines and substations
tgrac_tcur.validation_note: read correctly; accuracy and survey date not published

tgrac_endow.name: Endowment properties
tgrac_endow.limits: approximate locations; owner and personal layers deliberately not used

gwd_levels.name: Groundwater levels
gwd_levels.provider: Telangana Ground Water Department via Open Data Telangana
gwd_levels.coverage: 1,526 clean stations statewide, 115 in the Hyderabad area
gwd_levels.validation_note: Bahadurpura April-2025 minimum matches the official report exactly; Hyderabad June means within 0.7 m of official; wells 1.5 km apart differ by metres
gwd_levels.limits: needs at least 3 agreeing wells for an area estimate; swapped coordinates and placeholder positions were cleaned

gwd_quality.name: Groundwater quality samples
gwd_quality.provider: Telangana Ground Water Department via Open Data Telangana
gwd_quality.validation_note: downloaded and parsed; not compared with an independent laboratory source
gwd_quality.limits: scattered samples; one sample says nothing about the water at a house

civic_landfill.name: Landfills and dump yards
civic_landfill.licence_note: terms of each original dataset not confirmed

civic_traffic.name: Traffic choke points and planned junction improvements
civic_traffic.provider: Lakeer open-GIS repository (Hyderabad Traffic Police, GHMC)
civic_traffic.limits: undated; short lists, not a traffic study

civic_wq.name: Lake, river and STP water quality

landsat_lst.name: Surface heat in the dry season
landsat_lst.provider: Landsat 8/9 Level-2 (USGS) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
landsat_lst.validation_note: across 27 mandals the ranking did not agree with station air temperature (Spearman -0.09, p = 0.66; stations differ by only about 2 C, so the test is weak)
landsat_lst.limits: surface, not air, temperature; reported with low confidence

landsat_ndvi.name: Dry-season greenness (NDVI)
landsat_ndvi.provider: Landsat 8/9 Level-2 (USGS) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
landsat_ndvi.validation_note: physically consistent (park greenest, old city least) but not compared with an independent vegetation product

seismic_ref.name: Earthquake zone
seismic_ref.validation_note: not checked against the BIS standard itself; a newer edition may change zones

prices.name: Asking-price ranges
prices.provider: property-portal price-trend pages compiled with an AI assistant
prices.licence_note: high risk: portal data, indirect provenance; needs a licensed source before commercial use
prices.validation_note: portal figures disagree widely; asking prices, not registered deals
prices.limits: never a valuation; sample counts not available

hmda_zones.name: Planning-authority areas (which plan governs)
hmda_zones.provider: TGRAC HMDA layers (MCH, HUDA, CDA, HADA, HMR, HMR growth corridor) and mandal boundaries
hmda_zones.validation_note: checked at 14 known places (Gachibowli and Kondapur in CDA, Kukatpally and Uppal in HUDA, Shamshabad in HADA, Charminar and Banjara Hills in MCH)
hmda_zones.limits: undated; HMDA's jurisdiction was reportedly widened in 2025 (secondary source)

hmda_plans.name: Published master plans (documents)
hmda_plans.provider: HMDA: Revised Development Plan (circle PDFs), Master Plan 2031 mandal sheets, HUDA / HADA / CDA plans
hmda_plans.licence_note: public HMDA website; reuse terms not confirmed
hmda_plans.validation_note: file dates are upload dates (2021-2022), not plan dates; sheets are 23-29 MB images, not georeferenced
hmda_plans.limits: SETU does not read them and cannot state the land-use zone of any plot

tgrac_cadastral.name: Survey-parcel outlines
tgrac_cadastral.coverage: survey parcels across most of the study box; the old MCH core is mostly a single placeholder polygon
tgrac_cadastral.licence_note: terms not confirmed; owner fields never requested
tgrac_cadastral.validation_note: SNo is a village serial, not a survey number; about 1% of numbers are flagged duplicate or unreadable at source; accuracy and survey date not published
tgrac_cadastral.limits: a drawn outline is not a legal boundary and says nothing about title

tgrac_prohib.name: Parcels carrying a prohibitory-land category
tgrac_prohib.coverage: 812 parcels in the study box, mostly outside the old city
tgrac_prohib.validation_note: legal basis, date and completeness not documented; the official prohibited-property list is reported to have contained many wrongly listed parcels
tgrac_prohib.limits: NOT the registration department's register; free-text categories

hmwssb_network.name: HMWSSB mapped water-supply pipes and sewer lines; service sections
hmwssb_network.coverage: supply pipes across most of the city; sewer lines only for the 'core city'
hmwssb_network.licence_note: terms not confirmed; pipe geometry is not redistributed, only coarse cell presence
hmwssb_network.validation_note: mapping completeness is uneven (900 m boxes hold from 0 to over 700 pipe segments); a pipe on the map is not a connection
hmwssb_network.limits: no mapped pipe never means no supply; a mapped pipe never means a working tap

none.name: No source
none.validation_note: no data: the report says so and never fills a value

sus.scope_text: the whole ward, not the street
sus.missing: outside the 145 GHMC wards the model is not applied
sus.label: Flood susceptibility (SETHU model)

depth.scope_text: the whole ward, a stated-rain scenario
depth.missing: outside the 145 GHMC wards the model is not applied
depth.label: Modelled water depth in a 192 mm storm

storms.scope_text: the ward's mandal in 8 documented floods
storms.missing: mandal not among the 27 with rainfall data
storms.label: What this ward's mandal recorded in 8 documented floods

heavyrain.missing: mandal not among the 27 with complete monsoon seasons
heavyrain.label: Heavy-rain days per monsoon in this mandal

analog.scope_text: the ward's mandal, six dated storms
analog.missing: fewer than 3 qualifying storms or mandal not covered
analog.label: Storm analogs (preliminary historical association)

pocket.scope_text: about 1 km around the pin, 90 m terrain
pocket.missing: the elevation service did not answer
pocket.label: Low pocket vs surroundings

lake.scope_text: lakes and tanks near the pin; the outline is not the legal boundary
lake.label: Lake / tank proximity

nalaenc.missing: encroachment fields are blank in the source
nalaenc.label: Recorded encroachment on this nala

hmda.scope_text: the nearest tank matched by name
hmda.label: HMDA lake notification

shelter.scope_text: listed centres within a stated distance
shelter.label: Flood rehabilitation centres nearby

gwdepth.scope_text: median of at least 3 agreeing wells within 3 km
gwdepth.missing: fewer than 3 wells nearby, or the wells disagree
gwdepth.label: Groundwater depth around here (median of nearby wells)

gwpre.label: Depth at the end of the dry season (Apr–May)

gwtrend.missing: too little history in nearby wells

gwcov.label: How well monitored is this spot?

gwf.scope_text: samples within 3-5 km, not this well
gwf.label: Fluoride in nearby groundwater

gwno3.scope_text: samples within 3-5 km, not this well
gwno3.label: Nitrate in nearby groundwater

gwtds.scope_text: samples within 3-5 km, not this well
gwtds.label: Salinity (TDS) in nearby groundwater

gwp.scope_text: the regional map unit the pin falls in
gwp.label: Hydrogeology of the ground here (regional map)

tankstore.missing: capacity is missing for 63% of tanks
tankstore.label: Mapped tank storage nearby

supply.scope_text: no data: connection, supply hours and tanker use are not published
supply.missing: no public record of connections, supply frequency or tanker dependence per address

supplynet.scope_text: mapped pipes in the 100 m cells around the pin

supplynet.label: Mapped HMWSSB supply pipe near the pin

sewernet.scope_text: mapped sewer lines in the 100 m cells around the pin (core city only)
sewernet.missing: sewer lines are mapped only for the core city
sewernet.label: Mapped sewer line near the pin

acc_hospital.scope_text: road route from the pin to the nearest mapped hospitals
acc_hospital.missing: the routing servers did not answer
acc_hospital.label: Hospital: road travel

acc_metro.missing: the routing servers did not answer

acc_school.missing: the routing servers did not answer

acc_market.missing: the routing servers did not answer
acc_market.label: Market / supermarket: road travel

air.missing: the air-quality service did not answer
air.label: Air quality right now

f_hospital.label: Hospital

f_school.scope_text: mapped places within a stated distance; service not verified
f_school.label: School

f_market.scope_text: mapped places within a stated distance
f_market.label: Market / supermarket

f_metro.scope_text: mapped stations within a stated distance
f_metro.label: Metro / rail station

f_bus.scope_text: mapped stations within a stated distance; frequency unknown
f_bus.label: Bus station

f_park.scope_text: mapped places within a stated distance
f_park.label: Park

f_bank.scope_text: mapped places within a stated distance
f_bank.label: Bank

f_police.scope_text: mapped stations within a stated distance
f_police.label: Police station

f_fire.scope_text: mapped stations within a stated distance
f_fire.label: Fire station

f_jobs.scope_text: mapped offices, malls and cinemas within 3-5 km
f_jobs.label: Jobs and lifestyle hubs

lost.scope_text: tested at the pin position, not matched to a parcel
lost.label: Disappeared water body

forest.scope_text: tested at the pin position, with distance if outside
forest.label: Forest land boundary

plot.scope_text: which surveyed parcel the pin falls in; boundaries are a drawn outline, not a legal boundary
plot.missing: no survey parcels are mapped here (the old city core), or the pin is on a road or unmapped land
plot.label: Plot identity (survey parcel)

prohib.scope_text: tested at the pin position against parcels listed in a state GIS layer
prohib.missing: no parcel mapped here, so the layer cannot be tested; the legal register is on the registration portal
prohib.label: Listed in a state prohibitory-land layer

planauth.scope_text: which authority's plan governs the area the pin is in

zoning.scope_text: no data: the plans are published as images and PDFs and are not read

perm.scope_text: no data: approvals are held in HMDA / DTCP systems
perm.missing: no public bulk record of layout and building permissions was reached

ftl.scope_text: lake outline distance; not the legal FTL
ftl.label: Lake buffer / FTL risk

widen.scope_text: nala segments within 150 m; widths partly blank
widen.label: Nala widening near the plot

overlap.scope_text: the whole matched survey outline, tested against three layers
overlap.missing: needs a pin that matches exactly one survey parcel; not possible in the old city core where no survey parcels are mapped
overlap.label: Mapped features overlapping the parcel outline
